since_previous.description: When a field was cleared in an update dialog, the dialog did not send an explicit empty value, so the clear could fail to take effect. Update dialogs now send explicit empty values. Clearing both fields of a checklist question's onboarding mapping now removes the mapping.

since_previous.title: Configurable event retention period
since_previous.description: Previously, events were kept forever. Now, events older than a configurable retention period are deleted by a scheduled task. Operators set WALDUR_EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS through Helm values or the Docker Compose environment. Leaving it empty or setting it to 0 keeps events forever, which is the default.

actions.description: Optionally set WALDUR_EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS (Helm value or Docker Compose .env) to delete events older than the given number of days. Empty or 0 keeps events forever.

since_previous.title: Dates formatted consistently in one date locale
since_previous.description: Previously, some dates were formatted with the browser locale or ad hoc tokens. Now, dates are formatted with Intl presets in a single app date locale. This includes the S3 object lock date.

since_previous.title: Feedback surveys and their questions authored in one wizard
since_previous.description: Previously, a feedback survey and its questions were created separately. Now, a single wizard covers survey details, audience and schedule, and questions. Questions can be copied from existing surveys.

since_previous.title: Helm pins postgres-minio and uvk-everypay images and pulls them on every start
since_previous.description: Previously, these images were not pinned to specific versions. Now, the Helm chart pins the postgres-minio backup image to 17 (rebuilt weekly in place) and uvk-everypay and its sidecar to release 0.2.0. Both are pulled on every run or start.

since_previous.title: Identity Bridge leaves existing privileged accounts unchanged for non-staff callers
since_previous.description: When a non-staff caller pushed an existing privileged account to the Identity Bridge, the account was not left as it was. The Identity Bridge now returns the existing privileged account unchanged.

since_previous.title: Increase-only component limits
since_previous.description: Previously, customers could lower a component's limit after ordering. Now, a service provider can mark a component's limit as increase-only, which prevents lowering it after ordering. The setting appears in the offering component dialog, is enforced in the change-limits dialogs, and is included in offering export and import.

actions.description: Apply marketplace migration 0329_offeringcomponent_limit_increase_only.

since_previous.title: Invoice items without an offering component show their own name
since_previous.description: An invoice item with no offering component was not shown under its own name in the invoice details. It now shows its own name.

since_previous.title: Keyboard-accessible icon tooltips and tidier property display
since_previous.description: Previously, some icon tooltips could not be reached with the keyboard, and single properties were wrapped in a one-item list. Now, the remaining icon tooltips are keyboard accessible, and single properties render on their own.

since_previous.title: Longhorn removal request links to its resource
since_previous.description: Previously, the Longhorn removal request did not link to the resource it concerns. Now, it does.

since_previous.title: MCP OAuth accepts CIMD clients that list extra grant types
since_previous.description: MCP OAuth rejected Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD) clients that listed extra grant types. These clients are now accepted.

since_previous.title: MCP server URLs in public settings and an AI client connection guide
since_previous.description: Previously, users had no guidance on connecting an AI client to Waldur's MCP server. Now, MCP server URLs are exposed in public settings, and the Connected apps tab shows how to connect an AI client.

since_previous.title: Metrics hide resources and projects the caller cannot see
since_previous.description: Metric reads could include resources and projects the caller cannot see, and the provider side did not follow the same rules as usage. Metric reads now hide those resources and projects, and the provider side follows the usage rules. Hidden metrics show an empty state instead of "Not found".

since_previous.title: Offering order flow diagram, and the order start date honoured everywhere
since_previous.description: Previously, there was no overview of how an offering's orders are approved and processed, and the order start date was not honoured on every processing path. Now, the API describes an offering's order flow, and the offering's Actions menu shows it as a swimlane diagram that can be exported. The order start date is honoured on every path.

since_previous.title: OpenStack tenant orders accept zero cores, RAM and storage limits
since_previous.description: OpenStack tenant orders rejected limits of zero for cores, RAM and storage. Zero is now accepted for these limits.

since_previous.title: OS security updates applied in the mastermind and homeport images
since_previous.description: Previously, the images used their base images' packages as shipped. Now, the mastermind image applies Debian security updates on top of the Python base image, and the homeport image applies Alpine security updates on top of the nginx base image.

since_previous.title: Preview Arrow billing changes before applying them
since_previous.description: Previously, staff could not see what Arrow billing actions would change before running them. Now, a Billing changes wizard in the Arrow admin previews invoice changes, and staff apply them only after reviewing them. Billing changes jobs have a total order.

actions.description: Apply waldur_arrow migrations 0010_arrow_billing_changes_job and 0011_arrow_billing_changes_job_total_order.

since_previous.title: Previous month's invoices stay open for 2 hours by default
since_previous.description: Previously, the previous month's invoices had a different default grace period, and the Helm chart always set the value itself. Now, they stay open for 2 hours by default. The Helm chart sets the grace period only when an operator configures it, and otherwise uses the mastermind default. The past-month usage rule now also applies to per-user usage reports.

since_previous.title: Proposal and review exports as Excel workbooks
since_previous.description: Previously, a call's proposal and review exports were not offered as Excel workbooks. Now, they can be downloaded as Excel workbooks.

since_previous.title: Resource API keys revealed with POST, and through a token with RESOURCE.REVEAL_API_KEY
since_previous.description: Now, resource API keys are revealed with a POST request. A personal access token that carries the RESOURCE.REVEAL_API_KEY permission can reveal them.

actions.description: Apply permissions migration 0039_reveal_api_key_permission.
Update API clients that reveal resource API keys to use POST.

since_previous.title: Reviewers give a reason when sending back an accepted review
since_previous.description: Previously, a reviewer could send back an accepted review without giving a reason. Now, the reviewer can say why, and the call's managers are notified with that reason.

actions.description: Apply proposal migration 0109_review_decline_reason.

since_previous.title: SLURM policy options shown only for site-agent offerings
since_previous.description: Previously, the SLURM lifecycle policy options also appeared on offerings that do not use the site agent. Now, they are shown only for site-agent offerings.

since_previous.title: SSH port for an offering's SCIM login nodes
since_previous.description: Previously, an offering's SCIM login node details did not include an SSH port. Now, the SSH port is exposed and can be set in the offering's user management settings.

since_previous.title: Staff can accept an invitation for a verified user whose email differs
since_previous.description: Previously, an invitation could not be accepted for a user whose verified email differed from the invited address. Now, staff can accept such an invitation on the user's behalf.

since_previous.title: Terminated resources counted over the same usage period as active ones
since_previous.description: Terminated resources were counted over a different usage period than active resources. Both are now counted over the same period.

since_previous.title: Theme switch moved back into the account menu
since_previous.description: Previously, the theme switch was in the application header. Now, it is back in the account menu.

since_previous.title: Token wizard with a site-agent template, service accounts and OFFERING.MANAGE_AGENT
since_previous.description: Previously, personal access tokens were created in a single dialog, and a site agent needed broader permissions to run. Now, tokens are created in a wizard that includes a site-agent template. A site agent can run with the OFFERING.MANAGE_AGENT permission, and users can be marked as service accounts. Owners of a service provider organization are offered the Create agent token action.

since_previous.description: Previously, the user data access log cleanup was not scheduled. Now, it runs as a scheduled Celery task.
